description: Grandfathered per-source cursor values an operator recorded from the legacy single-cursor watermark immediately before the durable per-source checkpoint system (source_checkpoints) existed. Used to bootstrap tests/fixtures/watermark/legacy-production.db's checkpoints and to assert the stored source_checkpoints.checkpoint_at TEXT equals each value byte-for-byte. Values are in Python's canonical datetime.isoformat() spelling (no microseconds when zero), because that is the exact form bootstrap_legacy_source_checkpoint persists.
